mister.zh: 先生（稱呼，常縮寫為 Mr.）

ex.en: Why is there a Miss Italy but no Mister Italy?
ex.zh: 為什麼有義大利小姐，卻沒有義大利先生？

ex.en: Excuse me, mister, you dropped your wallet.
ex.zh: 先生，不好意思，你的皮夾掉了。

ex.en: Hey, mister, is this seat taken?
ex.zh: 先生，請問這個位子有人坐嗎？

mister.en: a polite title put before the name of a man

ex.en: The hotel room has a mini fridge.
ex.zh: 飯店房間裡有一台迷你冰箱。

ex.en: We had a mini meeting before lunch.
ex.zh: 我們午餐前開了個簡短的小會議。

mini.en: much smaller than others of the same kind

ex.en: She wore a black mini to the party.
ex.zh: 她穿了一件黑色迷你裙去派對。

ex.en: He drives an old red Mini.
ex.zh: 他開一輛舊的紅色小車。

mini.en: a very short skirt, or a very small car

ex.en: Heads up! The server will shut down at midnight.
ex.zh: 注意！伺服器將在午夜關機。

ex.en: It was almost midnight when we got home.
ex.zh: 我們到家時已經快半夜了。

ex.en: He gave me a ring at midnight.
ex.zh: 他半夜打電話給我。

ex.en: We need to minimize costs this year.
ex.zh: 今年我們需要把成本降到最低。

ex.en: Back up your files to minimize the risk of data loss.
ex.zh: 備份檔案以降低資料遺失的風險。

minimize.en: to make something as small in amount as possible

ex.en: Minimize the window and open the file.
ex.zh: 把視窗縮到最小，然後打開檔案。

ex.en: Click here to minimize the browser.
ex.zh: 點這裡把瀏覽器縮到最小。

minimize.en: to make a window on a computer screen small or hide it from view

ex.en: For some reason the microphone didn't work earlier.
ex.zh: 不知道為什麼，剛才麥克風不能用。

ex.en: Tom put his hand over the microphone.
ex.zh: 湯姆把手放在麥克風上。

ex.en: Please speak into the microphone.
ex.zh: 請對著麥克風說話。

microphone.en: a device that makes sounds louder or records them

ex.en: This microscope magnifies objects by 100 times.
ex.zh: 這台顯微鏡可以把物體放大一百倍。

ex.en: Do you know the difference between a microscope and a telescope?
ex.zh: 你知道顯微鏡和望遠鏡有什麼不同嗎？

ex.en: Do you know who invented the microscope?
ex.zh: 你知道顯微鏡是誰發明的嗎？

microscope.en: an instrument that makes very small things look large enough to see

microscope.zh: under the microscope：受到嚴格檢視

ex.en: The company's finances are under the microscope.
ex.zh: 這家公司的財務正受到嚴格檢視。

ex.en: Every decision he makes is under the microscope.
ex.zh: 他做的每個決定都被放大檢視。

microscope.en: being studied very closely and carefully

ex.en: I didn't want to mislead anyone.
ex.zh: 我不想誤導任何人。

ex.en: He misled her.
ex.zh: 他誤導了她。

ex.en: It's a misleading title.
ex.zh: 這個標題有誤導性。

mislead.en: to make someone believe something that is not true

misplace.zh: 放錯地方（以致一時找不到）

ex.en: I seem to have misplaced my keys.
ex.zh: 我好像把鑰匙放錯地方了。

ex.en: Tom misplaced the contract and spent an hour looking for it.
ex.zh: 湯姆把合約亂放，花了一個小時才找到。

misplace.en: to put something somewhere and then be unable to find it

ex.en: Water, forests, and minerals are important natural resources.
ex.zh: 水、森林和礦物都是重要的天然資源。

ex.en: That country is rich in mineral resources.
ex.zh: 那個國家擁有豐富的礦產資源。

ex.en: A mine is where you find precious minerals.
ex.zh: 礦坑是可以找到珍貴礦物的地方。

mineral.en: a natural substance found in the ground or needed by the body

ex.en: I like to drink natural mineral water.
ex.zh: 我喜歡喝天然礦泉水。

ex.en: Can I have a bottle of mineral water?
ex.zh: 可以給我一瓶礦泉水嗎？

mineral.en: water from a natural spring that contains natural substances from the ground

ex.en: Generally speaking, the climate of Japan is mild.
ex.zh: 整體來說，日本的氣候很溫和。

ex.en: We had a mild winter last year.
ex.zh: 去年冬天很溫和。

ex.en: This country has a mild climate.
ex.zh: 這個國家氣候溫和。

mild.en: not too hot or cold, and not stormy

ex.en: Taiwanese food is milder than Indian food.
ex.zh: 台灣菜的口味比印度菜清淡。

ex.en: Can I have the mild curry, please?
ex.zh: 請給我不辣的咖哩好嗎？

mild.en: not strong or sharp in taste

ex.en: I have a mild headache.
ex.zh: 我有點輕微頭痛。

ex.en: Tom had a mild case of the flu.
ex.zh: 湯姆得了輕微的流感。

ex.en: The car has low mileage.
ex.zh: 這輛車的里程數很低。

ex.en: What's the mileage on this car?
ex.zh: 這輛車跑了多少里程？

mileage.en: the number of miles a vehicle has traveled

mileage.zh: 油耗（每加侖可行駛的英里數）

ex.en: This car gets good mileage.
ex.zh: 這輛車很省油。

ex.en: Hybrid cars get better mileage.
ex.zh: 油電混合車比較省油。

mileage.en: the number of miles a vehicle can travel on one gallon of fuel

ex.en: It is about time we bought a new microwave oven.
ex.zh: 我們該買一台新的微波爐了。

ex.en: Tom doesn't have a microwave oven.
ex.zh: 湯姆沒有微波爐。

ex.en: Heat the soup in the microwave for two minutes.
ex.zh: 把湯放進微波爐加熱兩分鐘。

microwave.en: an oven that cooks food quickly using short electric waves

ex.en: I usually microwave my lunch at the office.
ex.zh: 我通常在辦公室用微波爐熱午餐。

ex.en: Don't microwave food in metal containers.
ex.zh: 不要用金屬容器微波食物。

microwave.en: to cook or heat food in a special quick oven

ex.en: The witness misidentified the suspect.
ex.zh: 目擊者認錯了嫌犯。

ex.en: The app sometimes misidentifies plants in photos.
ex.zh: 這個 App 有時會認錯照片裡的植物。

misidentify.en: to say wrongly who or what a person or thing is

mid.zh: 中間的、中期的（多作字首，如 mid-July 七月中旬）

ex.en: The prefix "mid" means "middle," as in mid-July.
ex.zh: 字首「mid」表示「中間」，例如 mid-July（七月中旬）。

ex.en: Use "mid" with months, like mid-May or mid-June.
ex.zh: 「mid」可以和月份連用，例如 mid-May、mid-June。

mid.en: in the middle of a period of time or a place

ex.en: The Ministry of Education announced new rules.
ex.zh: 教育部宣布了新規定。

ex.en: He works at the Ministry of Finance.
ex.zh: 他在財政部工作。

ministry.en: a government department that deals with one area of public life

ex.en: How many is nine minus six?
ex.zh: 九減六等於多少？

ex.en: Eight minus four is four.
ex.zh: 八減四等於四。

ex.en: Seven minus two is five.
ex.zh: 七減二等於五。

minus.en: used to show that one number is taken away from another

ex.en: The temperature dropped to minus ten degrees.
ex.zh: 氣溫降到零下十度。

ex.en: He got an A minus on the test.
ex.zh: 他這次考試拿了 A-。

ex.en: They unveiled new ballistic missiles.
ex.zh: 他們發表了新型彈道飛彈。

ex.en: The country tested a new missile last week.
ex.zh: 該國上週試射了一枚新飛彈。

missile.en: a weapon that is sent through the air and explodes when it hits a target

ex.en: The union took a militant stance in the negotiations.
ex.zh: 工會在談判中採取強硬立場。

ex.en: She is a militant supporter of animal rights.
ex.zh: 她是激進的動物權利支持者。

militant.en: ready to use strong or forceful methods to get change

ex.en: The city has a large number of migrants from rural areas.
ex.zh: 這座城市有很多來自鄉村的移居者。

ex.en: Many migrant workers in Taiwan come from Southeast Asia.
ex.zh: 台灣有許多移工來自東南亞。

migrant.en: a person who moves to another place or country to find work or a better life

ex.en: The village formed a militia to protect itself.
ex.zh: 村民組成民兵自衛。

ex.en: The militia was disbanded after the war.
ex.zh: 戰後民兵組織就解散了。

militia.en: a group of ordinary people trained as soldiers who can fight in an emergency

ex.en: The damage to the car was minimal.
ex.zh: 車子的損傷很輕微。

ex.en: This printer requires minimal maintenance.
ex.zh: 這台印表機幾乎不需要保養。

ex.en: The project was completed at minimal cost.
ex.zh: 這個專案以最低的成本完成。

minimal.en: as small in amount as possible

ex.en: My grandfather worked in a paper mill.
ex.zh: 我爺爺以前在造紙廠工作。

ex.en: The old mill by the river is now a museum.
ex.zh: 河邊那座老磨坊現在是博物館。

mill.en: a factory that makes certain goods, or a building where grain is made into flour

ex.en: Pass me the pepper mill, please.
ex.zh: 請把胡椒研磨罐遞給我。

ex.en: This coffee mill is easy to clean.
ex.zh: 這台咖啡磨豆機很好清洗。

mill.en: a small tool for crushing things such as pepper or coffee into powder

ex.en: Bird migration happens every autumn.
ex.zh: 每年秋天都會有候鳥遷徙。

ex.en: Migration from rural areas to cities is increasing.
ex.zh: 從鄉村移居到城市的人越來越多。

migration.en: the movement of people or animals from one place to another

ex.en: The data migration took two weekends.
ex.zh: 資料移轉花了兩個週末。

ex.en: We are planning a migration to the cloud.
ex.zh: 我們正在規劃把系統移轉到雲端。

migration.en: the process of moving data or a system from one place to another

ex.en: We need to look at the problem on a micro level.
ex.zh: 我們需要從微觀層面來看這個問題。

ex.en: The bank offers loans to micro businesses.
ex.zh: 這家銀行提供微型企業貸款。

micro.en: extremely small, or looking at small details

ex.en: Please don't misunderstand me.
ex.zh: 請不要誤會我的意思。

ex.en: Tom speaks French so badly that he's often misunderstood.
ex.zh: 湯姆法文說得很差，常常被人誤會。

ex.en: Anything that can be misunderstood will be.
ex.zh: 凡是可能被誤解的，就一定會被誤解。

misunderstand.en: to fail to understand someone or something correctly

ex.en: This case might not get resolved for a while.
ex.zh: 這個案子可能短時間內解決不了。

ex.en: She was worried that she might miss the train.
ex.zh: 她擔心自己可能會趕不上火車。

ex.en: Academic fraud is more common than you might think.
ex.zh: 學術造假比你想像的還普遍。

might.en: used to say that something is possible but not certain

ex.en: Since you are here, we might as well begin.
ex.zh: 既然你來了，我們不如就開始吧。

ex.en: It's raining, so we might as well stay home.
ex.zh: 在下雨，我們不如待在家吧。

might.en: used to say that doing something is fine because there is no better choice

ex.en: Would you mind my staying here for some time?
ex.zh: 你介意我在這裡待一會兒嗎？

ex.en: Do you mind if I turn off the light?
ex.zh: 你介意我把燈關掉嗎？

ex.en: I don't mind being criticized when I am wrong.
ex.zh: 我說錯時被批評，我並不介意。

mind.en: to feel annoyed or upset about something

ex.en: I can't get the song out of my mind.
ex.zh: 那首歌一直在我腦海裡揮之不去。

ex.en: She has a sharp mind.
ex.zh: 她頭腦很敏銳。

mind.en: the part of a person that thinks, feels and remembers

ex.en: Whatever he may say, I won't change my mind.
ex.zh: 無論他說什麼，我都不會改變主意。

ex.en: Tom changed his mind about the trip.
ex.zh: Tom 對這趟旅行改變了主意。

mind.en: to decide something different from what you decided before

ex.en: Please keep in mind that the office closes at five.
ex.zh: 請記得辦公室五點就關門。

ex.en: Bear in mind that prices may change.
ex.zh: 請記住價格可能會變動。

mind.en: to remember something and think about it when you make decisions

ex.en: Will you listen to me for a few minutes?
ex.zh: 你願意聽我說幾分鐘嗎？

ex.en: I think we had better wait another thirty minutes.
ex.zh: 我想我們最好再等三十分鐘。

ex.en: The new secretary types about 70 words per minute.
ex.zh: 新來的秘書每分鐘大約打七十個字。

minute.en: a period of time equal to sixty seconds

ex.en: Wait a minute, please.
ex.zh: 請稍等一下。

ex.en: Do you have a minute?
ex.zh: 你有空一下嗎？

minute.en: a very short period of time

ex.en: Amy took the minutes at the meeting.
ex.zh: Amy 在會議上負責做會議紀錄。

ex.en: Please send the minutes to everyone.
ex.zh: 請把會議紀錄寄給大家。

minute.en: a written record of what was said and decided at a meeting

ex.en: The military power of this country is very advanced.
ex.zh: 這個國家的軍事力量非常先進。

ex.en: There is a military base near here.
ex.zh: 這附近有一個軍事基地。

ex.en: Every male Algerian citizen must do military service.
ex.zh: 每位阿爾及利亞男性公民都必須服兵役。

military.en: related to soldiers, armies or war

ex.en: The family was highly doubtful of the statement from the military.
ex.zh: 家屬對軍方的說法高度存疑。

ex.en: He joined the military after high school.
ex.zh: 他高中畢業後就從軍了。

military.en: the army, navy and air force of a country

ex.en: The town is two miles away from the coast.
ex.zh: 那個小鎮離海岸兩英里。

ex.en: My house is only a mile from here.
ex.zh: 我家離這裡只有一英里。

ex.en: A mile is equal to about 1,600 meters.
ex.zh: 一英里大約是一千六百公尺。

mile.en: a unit of distance equal to about 1.6 kilometers

ex.en: The library is in the middle of the city.
ex.zh: 圖書館位於市中心。

ex.en: A truck was standing in the middle of the road.
ex.zh: 路中間停著一輛卡車。

ex.en: The church is in the middle of the village.
ex.zh: 教堂位在村子的中央。

middle.en: the central part or point of something

middle.zh: in the middle of：正在……當中

ex.en: My PC is in the middle of an update.
ex.zh: 我的電腦正在更新。

ex.en: Sorry, I'm in the middle of a meeting.
ex.zh: 抱歉，我正在開會。

middle.en: busy doing something at this moment

ex.en: She is the middle child of three.
ex.zh: 她是三個孩子中排行中間的。

ex.en: He sat in the middle row.
ex.zh: 他坐在中間那一排。

middle.en: in the center, between two other things

ex.en: Your camera is only half the size of mine.
ex.zh: 你的照相機只有我那臺的一半大小。

ex.en: She has a view that is different from mine.
ex.zh: 她的看法和我的不同。

ex.en: Your plan is very good, but mine is better.
ex.zh: 你們的計畫很好，但我的更好。

mine.en: the thing or things that belong to me

ex.en: His father worked in a coal mine.
ex.zh: 他父親在煤礦工作。

ex.en: The old gold mine is now a museum.
ex.zh: 那座老金礦現在是一座博物館。

mine.en: a deep hole or tunnel in the ground where coal, metal or stone is dug out

ex.en: If you mix blue and red, you'll get purple.
ex.zh: 藍色和紅色混在一起就會變成紫色。

ex.en: Add water and mix to a firm dough.
ex.zh: 加水攪拌成結實的麵團。

ex.en: I don't like to mix business with pleasure.
ex.zh: 我不喜歡把工作和玩樂混在一起。

mix.en: to combine different things so that they become one

ex.en: She frequently gets sugar and salt mixed up.
ex.zh: 她常把糖和鹽搞混。

ex.en: I always mix up their names.
ex.zh: 我總是搞混他們的名字。

mix.en: to confuse one person or thing with another

ex.en: I have mixed feelings about this.
ex.zh: 我對這件事心情很複雜。

ex.en: The movie got mixed reviews.
ex.zh: 這部電影的評價褒貶不一。

mix.en: made up of different or opposite kinds of things

ex.en: The team has a good mix of young and experienced staff.
ex.zh: 團隊裡年輕和資深員工的組合很好。

ex.en: I bought a cake mix at the supermarket.
ex.zh: 我在超市買了一包蛋糕預拌粉。

mix.en: a combination of different people or things

ex.en: I am charged with an important mission.
ex.zh: 我肩負一項重要任務。

ex.en: Who picked you for this mission?
ex.zh: 誰選你來執行這個任務的？

ex.en: With their cooperation, the mission had been successfully finished.
ex.zh: 在他們的默契合作下，任務順利完成了。

mission.en: an important job that a person or group is sent to do

ex.en: Our mission is to make healthy food affordable for everyone.
ex.zh: 我們的使命是讓每個人都吃得起健康的食物。

ex.en: Every employee should know the company's mission statement.
ex.zh: 每位員工都應該了解公司的使命宣言。

mission.en: the main purpose or goal of an organization

ex.en: A trade mission from Japan visited our factory.
ex.zh: 一個日本貿易代表團參觀了我們的工廠。

ex.en: She joined a diplomatic mission to Europe.
ex.zh: 她加入了前往歐洲的外交使節團。

mission.en: a group of people sent to another country for a special purpose

ex.en: What is the minimum wage in Georgia?
ex.zh: 請問喬治亞州的最低工資是多少？

ex.en: Today's minimum temperature was 3 °C.
ex.zh: 今天的最低氣溫是攝氏三度。

minimum.en: smallest in amount that is possible or allowed

ex.en: Keep costs to a minimum.
ex.zh: 把成本壓到最低。

ex.en: You need a minimum of three years' experience.
ex.zh: 你至少需要三年經驗。

minimum.en: the smallest amount that is possible or allowed

ex.en: Add a little more milk to my tea, please.
ex.zh: 請在我的茶裡再加點牛奶。

ex.en: I bought a few eggs and a little milk.
ex.zh: 我買了幾顆蛋和一點牛奶。

ex.en: Ziri went to his fridge to grab some milk.
ex.zh: 齊里走到冰箱前拿牛奶。

milk.en: the white liquid from cows that people drink, or the liquid that a mother feeds her baby

ex.en: He could be found at 6 o'clock every morning in the barn, milking the cows.
ex.zh: 每天早上六點都可以在牛棚裡看到他在擠牛奶。

ex.en: The farmer milks the cows twice a day.
ex.zh: 農夫每天擠兩次牛奶。

milk.en: to take liquid food from a cow or other animal

ex.en: Only a minority of employees work from home.
ex.zh: 只有少數員工在家工作。

ex.en: A small minority of customers complained about the price.
ex.zh: 只有一小部分顧客抱怨價格。

minority.en: a smaller part of a group of people or things

ex.en: The law protects the rights of minorities.
ex.zh: 這項法律保障少數族群的權利。

ex.en: Minority groups are often underrepresented in management.
ex.zh: 少數族群在管理階層中的比例往往偏低。

minority.en: a group of people with a different race or religion from most people in a country

ex.en: He played a minor part in the play.
ex.zh: 他在劇中演一個小角色。

ex.en: A couple of flights were delayed on account of a minor accident.
ex.zh: 因為一起小事故，有幾班航班延誤了。

minor.en: small and not very important or serious

ex.en: She's still a minor.
ex.zh: 她還未成年。

ex.en: I'm a minor.
ex.zh: 我未成年。

minor.en: a person who is not yet legally an adult

ex.en: She majored in business and minored in English.
ex.zh: 她主修商業，副修英文。

ex.en: I'm minoring in economics this year.
ex.zh: 我今年副修經濟學。

minor.en: to study a subject at college as your second subject

ex.en: She stopped before the mirror to admire herself.
ex.zh: 她在鏡子前停下來欣賞自己。

ex.en: Tom looked at his reflection in the mirror.
ex.zh: 湯姆看著鏡中的自己。

ex.en: He picked up a mirror and examined his tongue.
ex.zh: 他拿起一面鏡子仔細看自己的舌頭。

mirror.en: a glass surface in which you can see yourself

ex.en: The novel mirrors the author's own life.
ex.zh: 這本小說反映了作者自己的人生。

ex.en: Sales trends mirror changes in consumer habits.
ex.zh: 銷售趨勢反映了消費習慣的改變。

mirror.en: to show or be very similar to something else

ex.en: As everyone knows, air is a mixture of gases.
ex.zh: 眾所皆知，空氣是多種氣體的混合物。

ex.en: Blend the mixture together until it is smooth.
ex.zh: 把混合物攪拌到滑順為止。

ex.en: Every opinion is a mixture of truth and error.
ex.zh: 任何意見都是事實與錯誤的混合。

mixture.en: a substance made by combining different things

ex.en: The bar-tailed godwit migrates from Alaska to New Zealand.
ex.zh: 斑尾鷸從阿拉斯加遷徙到紐西蘭。

ex.en: The swallows are migrating.
ex.zh: 燕子正在遷徙。

ex.en: Many birds migrate south for the winter.
ex.zh: 許多鳥會往南遷徙過冬。

migrate.en: to travel to another region at a certain time of year

ex.en: Many young people migrate to cities to find work.
ex.zh: 許多年輕人移居城市找工作。

ex.en: His family migrated to Canada in the 1990s.
ex.zh: 他家在 1990 年代移民到加拿大。

migrate.en: to move to another place or country to live or work

ex.en: We plan to migrate our data to the cloud.
ex.zh: 我們計畫把資料轉移到雲端。

ex.en: The company migrated to a new email system.
ex.zh: 公司換到了新的電子郵件系統。

migrate.en: to move data or a system from one place to another

ex.en: The screw is five millimeters long.
ex.zh: 這顆螺絲長五毫米。

ex.en: Rainfall was measured in millimeters.
ex.zh: 降雨量以毫米為單位測量。

millimeter.en: a unit of length equal to one thousandth of a meter

ex.en: The miners work deep underground every day.
ex.zh: 礦工每天都在地底深處工作。

ex.en: His grandfather was a coal miner.
ex.zh: 他的祖父是煤礦工人。

miner.en: a person who works underground to dig out coal, metal or stone

ex.en: She collects miniature cars.
ex.zh: 她收集迷你小汽車。

ex.en: The architect showed us a miniature model of the building.
ex.zh: 建築師給我們看大樓的縮小模型。

miniature.en: much smaller than the usual size

ex.en: The museum displays miniatures of famous ships.
ex.zh: 博物館展示著名船艦的縮小模型。

ex.en: The park is like a city in miniature.
ex.zh: 這座公園就像一個縮小版的城市。

miniature.en: a very small copy of something, or a tiny painting

ex.en: If you see a mistake, then please correct it.
ex.zh: 如果你發現有錯的話請幫忙改正。

ex.en: Careful as he was, he made an unexpected mistake.
ex.zh: 他雖然很小心，還是犯了意想不到的錯。

ex.en: You continue making the same mistakes time after time.
ex.zh: 你一次又一次犯同樣的錯。

mistake.en: something that is wrong because of bad thinking or carelessness

mistake.zh: （mistake A for B）把 A 誤認為 B

ex.en: I didn't greet you because I mistook you for somebody else.
ex.zh: 我把你認成了別人，所以才沒有和你打招呼。

ex.en: You may have mistaken Jane for his sister.
ex.zh: 你可能把珍誤認成他妹妹了。

mistake.en: to wrongly think that one person or thing is another

ex.en: His illness caused her great misery.
ex.zh: 他的病使她非常傷心。

ex.en: The war brought misery to millions of people.
ex.zh: 戰爭給數百萬人帶來痛苦。

ex.en: The boy miraculously survived the fall.
ex.zh: 那個男孩奇蹟般地在墜落中存活下來。

ex.en: Miraculously, nobody was hurt in the crash.
ex.zh: 奇蹟般地，車禍中沒有人受傷。

miraculously.en: in a way that seems wonderful and impossible to explain

ex.en: He likes mischief.
ex.zh: 他喜歡惡作劇。

ex.en: The little boy had a look of mischief in his eyes.
ex.zh: 那個小男孩眼裡閃著淘氣的神色。

ex.en: The twins are always up to mischief.
ex.zh: 這對雙胞胎總是在搞惡作劇。

mischief.en: playful behavior that causes trouble but not serious harm

ex.en: Take one 500-milligram tablet twice a day after meals.
ex.zh: 每天兩次，飯後服用一顆五百毫克的藥錠。

ex.en: This drink contains 80 milligrams of caffeine.
ex.zh: 這杯飲料含有八十毫克的咖啡因。

milligram.en: a unit of weight equal to one thousandth of a gram

mingle.zh: （在社交場合）與人交際、打成一片

ex.en: At the party, she mingled with the guests and made new friends.
ex.zh: 派對上，她和賓客們聊天交流，交到了新朋友。

ex.en: New students are encouraged to mingle during the welcome lunch.
ex.zh: 迎新午餐時，學校鼓勵新生多多和大家互動。

mingle.en: to move around and talk to different people at a party

ex.en: The smell of coffee mingled with the scent of fresh bread.
ex.zh: 咖啡香和剛出爐麵包的香味交織在一起。

ex.en: Joy and sadness mingled in her heart on graduation day.
ex.zh: 畢業那天，她心中悲喜交加。

mingle.en: to combine or be mixed together

ex.en: As soon as you start misbehaving, Father Christmas will not come to see you.
ex.zh: 你只要一不乖，聖誕老公公就不會來看你了。

ex.en: The kids always misbehave when their parents aren't around.
ex.zh: 父母不在的時候，孩子們總是不守規矩。

ex.en: The news reported that the politician had a mistress for years.
ex.zh: 新聞報導那位政治人物多年來一直有個情婦。

ex.en: In the drama, the wife finds out about her husband's mistress.
ex.zh: 在這部連續劇裡，妻子發現了丈夫的情婦。

mistress.en: a woman who has a secret love relationship with a married man

ex.en: The dog ran happily to greet its mistress at the door.
ex.zh: 狗狗開心地跑到門口迎接女主人。

ex.en: She was the mistress of a large house with many servants.
ex.zh: 她是一棟大宅的女主人，有許多僕人。

mistress.en: a woman who owns or takes care of a pet or a house

ex.en: Social media can spread misinformation very quickly.
ex.zh: 社群媒體可能讓錯誤資訊迅速散播。

ex.en: The government launched a campaign against health misinformation.
ex.zh: 政府發起了打擊健康錯誤資訊的宣導活動。

misinformation.en: wrong or untrue information that is spread around

ex.en: The Foreign Minister said that war was inevitable.
ex.zh: 外交部長說戰爭無可避免。

ex.en: He is the prime minister of this country.
ex.zh: 他是這個國家的總理。

ex.en: This is the house in which the prime minister lives.
ex.zh: 這是總理住的房子。

minister.en: a person who is in charge of a government department

ex.en: The minister gave a short speech at the wedding.
ex.zh: 牧師在婚禮上簡短致詞。

ex.en: Her father is a church minister.
ex.zh: 她父親是教會的牧師。

minister.en: a person who leads religious services in some Christian churches

ex.en: The investigation found no evidence of misconduct.
ex.zh: 調查未發現不當行為的證據。

ex.en: Serious misconduct may lead to disciplinary action.
ex.zh: 嚴重失職可能導致懲處。

misconduct.en: bad or dishonest behavior by someone in a position of responsibility

ex.en: The microprocessor controls the device's main functions.
ex.zh: 微處理器控制這台裝置的主要功能。

ex.en: A faster microprocessor improved the machine's performance.
ex.zh: 更快速的微處理器提升了機器的效能。

microprocessor.en: a very small part inside a computer that controls its basic work

ex.en: The family rented a minivan for the weekend trip.
ex.zh: 這家人租了一輛廂型休旅車度週末。

ex.en: A minivan can carry the team"s equipment and six passengers.
ex.zh: 廂型休旅車可以載運團隊裝備和六名乘客。

minivan.en: a small van with seats for a family

ex.en: Drinks from the minibar will be added to your bill.
ex.zh: 迷你吧的飲料會加到你的帳單上。

ex.en: I took a bottle of water from the minibar.
ex.zh: 我從迷你吧拿了一瓶水。

minibar.en: a small fridge in a hotel room with drinks and snacks

ex.en: Hurry up, or you will miss the last train.
ex.zh: 再不快點你就要趕不上末班車了。

ex.en: Start at once, or you will miss the bus.
ex.zh: 馬上出發，不然你會錯過公車。

ex.en: She was worried that she might miss the train.
ex.zh: 她擔心她趕不上火車。

miss.en: to arrive too late for a bus, train or other event

ex.en: We shall all miss you when you go away.
ex.zh: 你走了，我們都會想你的。

ex.en: I will badly miss you if you leave Japan.
ex.zh: 如果你離開日本，我會非常想你的。

miss.en: to feel sad because someone is not with you

ex.en: There must be some misunderstanding between us.
ex.zh: 我們之間肯定有誤會。

ex.en: In order to avoid misunderstandings, they went through the contract again.
ex.zh: 為了避免誤解，他們又把合約看了一遍。

ex.en: It's all just a big misunderstanding.
ex.zh: 這全是一場大誤會。

misunderstanding.en: a failure to understand something correctly

ex.en: Launching the app was a major milestone for the team.
ex.zh: 推出這個 App 是團隊的重大里程碑。

ex.en: Turning 18 is an important milestone.
ex.zh: 滿 18 歲是人生的重要階段。

milestone.en: an important event or stage in the development of something

ex.en: We took steps to mitigate the risk.
ex.zh: 我們採取了措施來降低風險。

ex.en: Trees can help mitigate the effects of heat.
ex.zh: 樹木可以幫助緩解炎熱的影響。

mitigate.en: to make something bad less serious

ex.en: Who is taking the minutes today?
ex.zh: 今天誰負責做會議紀錄？

ex.en: I'll send the minutes of the meeting to everyone.
ex.zh: 我會把會議紀錄寄給大家。

minutes.en: a written record of what was said and decided at a meeting

ex.en: It is about ten minutes' walk to the station.
ex.zh: 從這裡走到車站大約十分鐘。

ex.en: I think we had better wait another thirty minutes.
ex.zh: 我想我們還是再多等三十分鐘吧。

minutes.en: periods of time that are each sixty seconds long

ex.en: It was a miracle that nobody was hurt in the accident.
ex.zh: 沒有人在事故中受傷，真是奇蹟。

ex.en: The doctors called her fast recovery a miracle.
ex.zh: 醫生稱她迅速康復為奇蹟。

ex.en: It would take a miracle to finish this work by tomorrow.
ex.zh: 要在明天前完成這份工作，除非出現奇蹟。

ex.en: The new vaccine is a miracle of modern science.
ex.zh: 這種新疫苗是現代科學的奇蹟。

ex.en: She bought a bag of mixed nuts at the market.
ex.zh: 她在市場買了一袋綜合堅果。

ex.en: The class is a mixed group of young and old students.
ex.zh: 這個班級有年輕與年長的學生混合在一起。

ex.en: I have mixed feelings about moving to a new city.
ex.zh: 對於搬到新城市，我的心情很複雜。

ex.en: The film got mixed reviews from critics.
ex.zh: 這部電影得到評論家褒貶不一的評價。

ex.en: There is a missing page in this book.
ex.zh: 這本書少了一頁。

ex.en: I'm looking for my missing wallet.
ex.zh: 我在找我不見的皮夾。

ex.en: The police are searching for the missing boy.
ex.zh: 警方正在搜尋失蹤的男孩。

ex.en: Two hikers have been reported missing in the mountains.
ex.zh: 有兩名登山客被通報在山中失蹤。

ex.en: The old temple stands in the midst of a quiet forest.
ex.zh: 那座古老的寺廟坐落在一片寧靜森林的中央。

ex.en: She stayed calm in the midst of all the noise.
ex.zh: 在一片嘈雜之中，她依然保持冷靜。

ex.en: Coal mining was once the main job in this town.
ex.zh: 採煤曾經是這個小鎮的主要行業。

ex.en: Mining can cause serious damage to the environment.
ex.zh: 採礦可能對環境造成嚴重破壞。

misleading.zh: 誤導的、容易讓人誤解的

ex.en: The title of the article is a bit misleading.
ex.zh: 這篇文章的標題有點誤導人。

ex.en: Be careful with misleading ads that promise quick results.
ex.zh: 要小心那些承諾速效的誤導性廣告。

ex.en: A thin mist covered the lake early in the morning.
ex.zh: 清晨一層薄霧籠罩著湖面。

ex.zh: 我們在山路上緩慢地穿過霧氣。

ex.en: My glasses mist up when I enter a warm room.
ex.zh: 我一進到溫暖的房間，眼鏡就會起霧。

ex.en: The windows misted over during the hot shower.
ex.zh: 洗熱水澡時，窗戶都起霧了。

ex.en: The missionary lived in the village for many years.
ex.zh: 那位傳教士在這個村子住了很多年。

ex.en: Missionaries built the first school in the area.
ex.zh: 傳教士在這個地區蓋了第一所學校。

ex.en: The city has more than two million people.
ex.zh: 這座城市有超過兩百萬人口。

ex.en: The company earned one million dollars last year.
ex.zh: 這家公司去年賺了一百萬元。

ex.en: Millions of people watched the game on TV.
ex.zh: 數百萬人在電視上收看了這場比賽。

ex.en: I have a million things to do today.
ex.zh: 我今天有一大堆事情要做。

ex.zh: 邁克爾是英語系國家很常見的名字。

ex.en: Michael plays the guitar in a small band.
ex.zh: 邁克爾在一個小樂團裡彈吉他。

ex.en: Please ask Michael to bring some water.
ex.zh: 請叫邁克爾帶點水來。

ex.en: Mike is a short form of the name Michael.
ex.zh: 麥克是邁克爾這個名字的簡稱。

ex.zh: 麥克每個星期六都和朋友踢足球。

ex.zh: 請對著麥克風說話，這樣大家才聽得到。

ex.zh: 歌手輕敲麥克風，確認它有沒有在運作。

ex.en: The midland of the country is mostly flat farmland.
ex.zh: 這個國家的中部地區大多是平坦的農田。

ex.en: She grew up in a small town in the English midlands.
ex.zh: 她在英格蘭中部的一個小鎮長大。

ex.en: The miller ground the wheat into flour.
ex.zh: 磨坊主人把小麥磨成麵粉。

ex.zh: 在那個古老的故事裡，有一位磨坊主人住在河邊。

ex.zh: 米勒先生是我們新來的數學老師。

ex.zh: 請把包裹寄給橡樹街的米勒一家。

microsoft.zh: 微軟公司（美國的軟體公司）

ex.zh: 微軟是一間總部位於美國的軟體公司。

ex.en: My father worked for Microsoft before he retired.
ex.zh: 我爸爸退休前在微軟工作。

ex.zh: 約翰·米爾頓是英國詩人，寫了《失樂園》。

ex.en: Milton is also used as a boy's first name.
ex.zh: 米爾頓也被用來當作男孩的名字。

ex.en: She felt miserable after losing her favorite necklace.
ex.zh: 她弄丟最喜歡的項鍊後覺得非常難過。

ex.en: He was miserable at his old job and finally quit.
ex.zh: 他在以前的工作很痛苦，最後辭職了。

miserable.zh: 糟糕的、令人不舒服的（天氣、環境）

ex.zh: 那是個又冷又糟的日子，整個下午都在下雨。

ex.en: We spent a miserable night in a tent with no heater.
ex.zh: 我們在沒有暖氣的帳篷裡度過了難受的一夜。

ex.en: The stray dog lived a miserable life on the streets.
ex.zh: 那隻流浪狗在街頭過著悲慘的生活。

ex.en: They lived in miserable conditions before the storm ended.
ex.zh: 在風暴結束前，他們處在悲慘的處境中。

ex.en: The mighty river flooded the valley after the storm.
ex.zh: 暴風雨過後，強大的河水淹沒了山谷。

ex.en: The king ruled a mighty empire for forty years.
ex.zh: 那位國王統治一個強大的帝國長達四十年。

ex.en: That was a mighty fine dinner, thank you.
ex.zh: 那頓晚餐好吃極了，謝謝你。

ex.en: You are looking mighty happy today.
ex.zh: 你今天看起來真的很開心。

ex.en: The city celebrated the start of the new millennium with fireworks.
ex.zh: 這座城市用煙火慶祝新千禧年的開始。

ex.en: The old temple has stood for more than a millennium.
ex.zh: 這座古廟已經屹立超過一千年。

ex.en: Milan is a large city in northern Italy.
ex.zh: 米蘭是義大利北部的一座大城市。

ex.en: Milan is well known for its fashion and its big cathedral.
ex.zh: 米蘭以時尚和宏偉的大教堂聞名。

ex.en: The ministerial meeting will take place in the capital next week.
ex.zh: 部長級會議下週將在首都舉行。

ex.en: He was given a ministerial post in the new government.
ex.zh: 他在新政府中獲得了一個部長職位。

ex.en: We should minimise the risk of mistakes by checking twice.
ex.zh: 我們應該透過再三檢查，把出錯的風險降到最低。

ex.en: The company is trying to minimise its costs this year.
ex.zh: 這家公司今年正努力把成本降到最低。

ex.en: We drove about fifty miles before stopping for lunch.
ex.zh: 我們開了大約五十英里才停下來吃午餐。

ex.en: The nearest hospital is only two miles from here.
ex.zh: 最近的醫院離這裡只有兩英里。

ex.zh: 她每天早上上班前都會跑好幾英里。

ex.zh: 他賣掉公司後成了百萬富翁。

ex.en: Few people become a millionaire by luck alone.
ex.zh: 很少人光靠運氣就成為百萬富翁。

ex.en: He controlled the ball in midfield and passed it forward.
ex.zh: 他在中場控制住球並向前傳。

ex.en: The team's strength is in midfield.
ex.zh: 這支球隊的強項在中場。

ex.en: The parrot can mimic human voices.
ex.zh: 這隻鸚鵡會模仿人的聲音。

ex.en: Kids often mimic what their parents do.
ex.zh: 小孩常會模仿父母的行為。

ex.en: He is a great mimic and can copy any accent.
ex.zh: 他很會模仿，任何口音都學得像。

ex.en: The mimic made the whole audience laugh.
ex.zh: 那位模仿者把全場觀眾都逗笑了。

ex.en: The soup had a milky color from the coconut.
ex.zh: 這道湯因為椰子而呈現乳白色。

ex.en: A milky fog covered the lake at dawn.
ex.zh: 黎明時，乳白色的霧籠罩著湖面。

ex.en: He drank a cup of sweet, milky tea.
ex.zh: 他喝了一杯又甜又濃奶味的茶。

ex.en: I like my coffee sweet and milky.
ex.zh: 我喜歡我的咖啡又甜又多奶。

ex.en: The first microcomputers were small and slow compared to today's laptops.
ex.zh: 第一代微電腦跟現在的筆電相比又小又慢。

ex.en: He built a simple microcomputer as a school project.
ex.zh: 他把製作一台簡單的微電腦當作學校的專題。

ex.en: The soup is mildly spicy.
ex.zh: 這道湯有點微辣。

ex.en: He was mildly surprised by the news.
ex.zh: 他對這個消息稍微感到驚訝。

ex.en: To put it mildly, the movie was disappointing.
ex.zh: 說得客氣點，這部電影令人失望。

ex.en: The food was, to put it mildly, not very good.
ex.zh: 那些食物說得客氣點，不怎麼好吃。

ex.en: We stopped to rest at midday.
ex.zh: 我們在中午時停下來休息。

ex.en: The sun is hottest around midday.
ex.zh: 正午前後太陽最毒。

ex.en: We had a quick midday meal at the park.
ex.zh: 我們在公園簡單吃了午餐。

ex.en: The midday heat made everyone sleepy.
ex.zh: 正午的炎熱讓大家昏昏欲睡。

ex.en: He grew up in the Midlands, in central England.
ex.zh: 他在英格蘭中部的米德蘭地區長大。

ex.en: Birmingham is one of the largest cities in the Midlands.
ex.zh: 伯明罕是米德蘭地區最大的城市之一。

mickey.zh: 取笑（take the mickey，英式口語）

ex.en: Stop taking the mickey, I'm trying to be serious.
ex.zh: 別再取笑我了，我是認真的。

ex.en: His friends took the mickey out of him for his silly hat.
ex.zh: 朋友們因為他那頂蠢帽子取笑他。

ex.zh: 我們用牛絞肉做義大利麵醬。

ex.en: Mince is cheap and easy to cook.

ex.zh: 一個小失誤就可能讓公司損失很多錢。

ex.en: The politician's misstep made headlines the next day.
ex.zh: 那位政治人物的失策隔天就登上新聞頭條。

ex.en: The room was filled with mirth when he told the joke.
ex.zh: 他講完笑話後，整個房間充滿歡笑聲。

ex.en: She could not hide her mirth at the silly hat.
ex.zh: 看到那頂傻氣的帽子，她藏不住笑意。

ex.en: We took a minibus from the airport to the hotel.
ex.zh: 我們搭小型巴士從機場到飯店。

ex.en: The school rented a minibus for the field trip.
ex.zh: 學校租了一輛小型巴士去校外教學。

ex.en: He struggled mightily to lift the heavy box.
ex.zh: 他使盡全力想把那個重箱子抬起來。

ex.en: The team was mightily relieved when the rain stopped.
ex.zh: 雨停時，全隊都大大鬆了一口氣。

ex.en: My sister is a minimalist and owns very few things.
ex.zh: 我姊姊是個極簡主義者，擁有的東西很少。

ex.en: The artist is known as a minimalist who uses simple shapes.
ex.zh: 這位藝術家以使用簡單形狀的極簡主義風格聞名。

ex.en: They chose a minimalist design for the living room.
ex.zh: 他們為客廳選擇了極簡的設計。

ex.en: The website has a clean, minimalist look.
ex.zh: 這個網站外觀乾淨簡約。

ex.en: The mime pretended to be trapped inside an invisible box.
ex.zh: 啞劇演員假裝被困在一個看不見的箱子裡。

ex.en: We watched a street mime perform in the park on Sunday.
ex.zh: 我們週日在公園看了一位街頭啞劇演員的表演。

ex.en: She had to mime the word so her team could guess it.
ex.zh: 她必須用動作比出這個字，讓隊友來猜。

ex.en: He mimed opening a door because he had no key.
ex.zh: 他沒有鑰匙，所以只好比出開門的動作。

ex.en: I misread the sign and turned the wrong way.
ex.zh: 我看錯了路標，轉錯了方向。

ex.en: He misread her silence as anger.
ex.zh: 他把她的沉默誤解成生氣。

ex.en: The travelers saw a mirage of water in the desert.
ex.zh: 旅人在沙漠中看到水的海市蜃樓。

ex.en: His dream of quick money was only a mirage.
ex.zh: 他想快速致富的夢想只是個幻影。

ex.en: There is a mismatch between your skills and the job.
ex.zh: 你的技能與這份工作並不相配。

ex.en: The mismatch in size made the parts impossible to join.
ex.zh: 尺寸不合使得這些零件無法接合。

ex.en: Be careful not to mismatch the socks.
ex.zh: 小心不要把襪子配錯對。

ex.en: The system will mismatch the files if names are wrong.
ex.zh: 如果名稱錯誤，系統會把檔案配錯。

ex.en: Milking begins at five every morning on the farm.
ex.zh: 農場每天早上五點開始擠奶。

ex.en: The milking is done by machine now.
ex.zh: 現在擠奶都是用機器完成的。

ex.en: He caught the fastball in his leather mitt.
ex.zh: 他用皮製手套接住了那顆快速球。

ex.en: She wore thick oven mitts to take the hot tray out.
ex.zh: 她戴上厚厚的隔熱手套把熱烤盤拿出來。

ex.en: The union's growing militancy worried the factory owners.
ex.zh: 工會日益增強的戰鬥性讓工廠老闆感到擔憂。

ex.en: Political militancy can make peaceful talks more difficult.
ex.zh: 政治上的好戰態度可能讓和平談判更困難。

ex.en: Michigan borders four of the five Great Lakes.
ex.zh: 密西根州與五大湖中的四個湖相鄰。

ex.en: Detroit is the largest city in Michigan.
ex.zh: 底特律是密西根州最大的城市。

ex.en: The cafe is at the midpoint between our two houses.
ex.zh: 這間咖啡店位在我們兩家的中間點。

ex.en: We reached the midpoint of the hike around noon.
ex.zh: 我們中午左右走到健行路線的中點。

ex.en: The ad misrepresents what the product can actually do.
ex.zh: 這則廣告歪曲了產品的實際功能。

ex.en: He accused the newspaper of misrepresenting his words.
ex.zh: 他指控報紙曲解了他的話。

ex.en: She lost one mitten on the way to school.
ex.zh: 她在上學的路上掉了一隻連指手套。

ex.en: Babies wear a mitten to keep from scratching their faces.
ex.zh: 嬰兒戴著連指手套，以免抓傷臉。

ex.en: My missus is cooking dinner tonight.
ex.zh: 我太太今晚煮晚餐。

ex.en: Ask the missus if she wants to join us.
ex.zh: 問一下你太太想不想跟我們一起來。

ex.en: Minnesota is known as the Land of 10,000 Lakes.
ex.zh: 明尼蘇達州被稱為萬湖之地。

ex.en: Winters in Minnesota can be very cold.
ex.zh: 明尼蘇達州的冬天可能非常寒冷。

mirrored.zh: 反映；映照（mirror 的過去式）

ex.en: The calm lake mirrored the mountains.
ex.zh: 平靜的湖面映照出群山的倒影。

ex.en: Her smile mirrored the joy of the whole crowd.
ex.zh: 她的笑容反映出全場群眾的喜悅。

ex.en: A human hair is about seventy microns thick.
ex.zh: 人的頭髮大約有七十微米粗。

ex.en: The filter can catch particles larger than one micron.
ex.zh: 這個濾網能攔下大於一微米的微粒。

ex.en: The teacher warned the class that misbehavior would not be tolerated.
ex.zh: 老師警告全班，不當行為不會被容忍。

ex.en: His constant misbehavior got him sent to the principal's office.
ex.zh: 他一再行為不端，被送到校長室。

ex.en: In some regions, people eat millet porridge for breakfast.
ex.zh: 在某些地區，人們早餐吃小米粥。

ex.en: Farmers grow millet because it can survive in dry weather.
ex.zh: 農民種植小米，因為它在乾旱天氣也能存活。

ex.en: A millisecond is one thousandth of a second.
ex.zh: 一毫秒是千分之一秒。

ex.en: The website loads in under a hundred milliseconds.
ex.zh: 這個網站在一百毫秒內就能載入。

ex.en: The old militiaman kept his musket by the door.
ex.zh: 那位老民兵把他的火槍放在門邊。

ex.en: Each village sent a militiaman to guard the bridge.
ex.zh: 每個村莊都派了一名民兵去守橋。

ex.en: The boxer was hit in the midsection and fell to his knees.
ex.zh: 拳擊手腹部中拳而跪倒在地。

ex.en: The midsection of the bridge was closed for repairs.
ex.zh: 橋的中段因維修而封閉。

ex.en: A small miscalculation caused the budget to fall short.
ex.zh: 一個小小的計算失誤讓預算出現短缺。

ex.en: The delay was the result of a miscalculation of travel time.
ex.zh: 這次延誤是因為低估了路程時間。

ex.en: The report describes the mistreatment of workers.
ex.zh: 報告描述了勞工遭受不當對待的情形。

ex.en: Animal mistreatment is against the law.
ex.zh: 虐待動物是違法的。

ex.en: Many pets have a microchip under the skin for identification.
ex.zh: 許多寵物皮膚下都植入微晶片來辨識身分。

ex.en: A single microchip can store a huge amount of data.
ex.zh: 一片微晶片就能儲存大量的資料。

ex.en: He admitted his misdeeds and apologized to everyone.
ex.zh: 他承認自己做過的壞事，並向大家道歉。

ex.en: The child was punished for his misdeed.
ex.zh: 這個孩子因為做了壞事而受到處罰。

ex.en: He studied microelectronics at university.
ex.zh: 他在大學主修微電子學。

ex.en: Microelectronics is the study of very small electronic parts.
ex.zh: 微電子學是研究非常微小的電子元件的學問。

ex.en: Microscopy allows scientists to see tiny cells.
ex.zh: 顯微鏡檢查讓科學家能看見微小的細胞。

ex.en: She studied electron microscopy at graduate school.
ex.zh: 她在研究所學習電子顯微鏡學。

ex.en: There was mildew on the shower curtain.
ex.zh: 浴簾上長了黴。

ex.en: Damp walls often lead to mildew.
ex.zh: 潮濕的牆壁常會長黴。

ex.en: Wet clothes will mildew if you leave them in the bag.
ex.zh: 濕衣服放在袋子裡會發黴。

ex.en: The books mildewed in the damp basement.
ex.zh: 那些書在潮濕的地下室裡發黴了。

ex.en: The garage sells midget cars for children's races.
ex.zh: 這間車行賣供兒童比賽用的迷你車。

ex.en: They sailed a midget boat across the small pond.
ex.zh: 他們划著一艘迷你小船橫越小池塘。

ex.en: I misjudged the distance and missed the jump.
ex.zh: 我判斷錯了距離，沒跳過去。

ex.en: Don't misjudge him just because he is quiet.
ex.zh: 別因為他安靜就誤判他這個人。

misfit.zh: 格格不入的人；不合適的東西

ex.en: He felt like a misfit at the new school.
ex.zh: 他在新學校覺得自己格格不入。

ex.en: The story is about a group of misfits who become friends.
ex.zh: 這個故事講述一群不合群的人成為朋友。

ex.en: Some insects have mimetic colors that copy dead leaves.
ex.zh: 有些昆蟲的擬態色彩模仿枯葉。

ex.en: Children learn language partly through mimetic behavior.
ex.zh: 孩子部分是透過模仿行為學會語言的。

ex.en: Let's not waste time on the minutia of the contract.
ex.zh: 我們別把時間浪費在合約的瑣碎細節上。

ex.en: She loves studying the minutia of history.
ex.zh: 她喜歡鑽研歷史的細枝末節。

ex.en: If you mishandle the equipment, it could break.
ex.zh: 如果你處理這個設備的方式不對，它可能會壞掉。

ex.en: The airline was criticized for how it mishandled the complaints.
ex.zh: 這家航空公司因為處理客訴不當而受到批評。

ex.en: Bad weather may militate against a good turnout.
ex.zh: 天氣不好可能會影響到場人數。

ex.en: Several factors militate against his chances of winning.
ex.zh: 有幾個因素對他獲勝的機會不利。

ex.en: "Fast food" is a misnomer when the line takes an hour.
ex.zh: 排隊要一小時的話，「速食」這個名稱就名不符實了。

ex.en: Calling this small shed a house is a misnomer.
ex.zh: 把這間小棚子叫做房子是名不副實。

ex.en: The minstrel sang about brave knights at the castle.
ex.zh: 吟遊詩人在城堡裡唱著勇敢騎士的故事。

ex.en: A traveling minstrel played the lute in the square.
ex.zh: 一位旅行的吟遊詩人在廣場上彈著魯特琴。

ex.en: By buying directly from the farm, you cut out the middleman.
ex.zh: 直接向農場購買，就能省去中間商。

ex.en: He acted as a middleman between the buyer and the seller.
ex.zh: 他擔任買賣雙方之間的中間人。

missouri.zh: （美國州名）密蘇里州；密蘇里河

ex.en: Missouri is a state in the middle of the United States.
ex.zh: 密蘇里州位於美國中部。

ex.en: The Missouri River is one of the longest rivers in North America.
ex.zh: 密蘇里河是北美洲最長的河流之一。

ex.en: The potter threw away the misshapen cup.
ex.zh: 陶藝家把形狀歪扭的杯子丟掉了。

ex.en: The old tree had a misshapen trunk.
ex.zh: 那棵老樹有個奇形怪狀的樹幹。

mitigating.zh: 減輕；緩和（mitigate 的現在分詞）

ex.en: The city is mitigating flood risk by building new drains.
ex.zh: 市政府正以興建新排水系統來減輕水災風險。

ex.en: Planting trees is one way of mitigating the heat in summer.
ex.zh: 種樹是緩解夏季酷熱的方法之一。

ex.en: Helping a neighbor in need is considered a mitzvah.
ex.zh: 幫助有需要的鄰居被視為一件善行。

ex.en: Visiting the sick is a mitzvah in Jewish tradition.
ex.zh: 探望病人在猶太傳統裡是一項善行。

michelangelo.zh: 米開朗基羅（義大利文藝復興藝術家）

ex.en: Michelangelo painted the ceiling of the Sistine Chapel in Rome.
ex.zh: 米開朗基羅在羅馬西斯汀禮拜堂繪製了天花板畫。

ex.en: Michelangelo also carved the famous statue of David.
ex.zh: 米開朗基羅也雕刻了著名的大衛像。

ex.en: The report misstated the company's profits for last year.
ex.zh: 這份報告錯誤陳述了公司去年的利潤。

ex.en: He misstated the facts and later had to apologize.
ex.zh: 他說錯了事實，後來不得不道歉。

ex.en: The inspector examined the document minutely.
ex.zh: 檢查員仔細地審視了這份文件。

ex.en: The plans were minutely detailed, down to every screw.
ex.zh: 計畫詳細到連每顆螺絲都有交代。

ex.en: The villain sent his minions to search the whole city.
ex.zh: 反派派他的手下搜遍了整座城市。

ex.en: He felt like a minion, doing whatever his boss asked without question.
ex.zh: 他覺得自己像個跑腿的小嘍囉，老闆說什麼就做什麼。

ex.en: There is a common misapprehension that carrots give you perfect eyesight.
ex.zh: 有個常見的誤解，以為吃胡蘿蔔就能讓視力變完美。

ex.en: He was under the misapprehension that the shop was open on Sundays.
ex.zh: 他誤以為這家店星期天有營業。

ex.en: My sister is a millennial who grew up with early computers.
ex.zh: 我姊姊是千禧世代，從小接觸早期的電腦。

ex.en: Many millennials prefer to rent instead of buying a home.
ex.zh: 許多千禧世代的人寧願租屋也不買房。

ex.en: He wore mismatched socks to school.
ex.zh: 他穿著不成對的襪子去上學。

ex.en: The mismatched chairs made the room look cozy.
ex.zh: 那些不成套的椅子讓房間看起來很溫馨。

ex.en: I always mislay my keys when I'm in a hurry.
ex.zh: 我趕時間時總是把鑰匙放到不知哪裡去。

ex.en: Please don't mislay the receipt; we need it for the refund.
ex.zh: 請別弄丟收據，我們退款時需要它。

ex.en: She wore a denim miniskirt with white sneakers.
ex.zh: 她穿著牛仔迷你裙配白色球鞋。

ex.en: The miniskirt became popular in the 1960s.
ex.zh: 迷你裙在 1960 年代變得流行。

ex.en: The book explains how militarism led the country into war.
ex.zh: 這本書說明了軍國主義如何把國家帶入戰爭。

ex.en: Many people protested against rising militarism.
ex.zh: 許多人抗議日益抬頭的軍國主義。

ex.en: She studies microbiology at the university.
ex.zh: 她在大學主修微生物學。

ex.en: Microbiology helps us understand how bacteria cause disease.
ex.zh: 微生物學幫助我們了解細菌如何引起疾病。

ex.en: People have grown rice in Asia for millennia.
ex.zh: 亞洲人種稻已經有數千年之久。

ex.en: The ruins have stood for millennia in the desert.
ex.zh: 這些遺跡在沙漠中矗立了數千年。

ex.en: The teacher spoke to his parents about his misbehaviour in class.
ex.zh: 老師就他在課堂上的不良行為與他的父母談話。

ex.en: Repeated misbehaviour may lead to punishment.
ex.zh: 一再的不當行為可能會受到處罰。

ex.en: Their camping trip ended in a funny misadventure.
ex.zh: 他們的露營之旅以一場有趣的倒楣事收場。

ex.en: He told us about his misadventure with the lost luggage.
ex.zh: 他跟我們說了行李遺失的倒楣遭遇。

ex.en: If you wait any longer to apply, you'll miss the boat.
ex.zh: 如果你再拖著不申請，就會錯失良機。

ex.en: He missed the boat by not buying the house years ago.
ex.zh: 他多年前沒買下那棟房子，因而錯失了機會。

ex.en: Don't miss the boat on this great sale.
ex.zh: 別錯過這次大特價的好機會。

miss the boat.en: to lose a chance to do something good by being too slow

ex.en: I always mix up my cousins' names.
ex.zh: 我總是把表兄弟姊妹的名字搞混。

ex.en: They mixed up the orders, so I got the wrong pizza.
ex.zh: 他們把訂單搞混了，所以我拿到錯的披薩。

ex.en: Don't mix up the two keys; they look alike.
ex.zh: 別把這兩把鑰匙搞混，它們長得很像。

mix up.en: to confuse one thing with another

ex.en: The wind mixed up all my papers.
ex.zh: 風把我所有的紙張都吹亂了。

ex.en: Someone mixed up the books on the shelf.
ex.zh: 有人把書架上的書弄亂了。

ex.en: Please don't mix up the cards before we finish.
ex.zh: 我們結束之前，請不要把牌弄亂。

mix up.en: to put things in the wrong order

ex.en: Mix up the eggs and flour in a large bowl.
ex.zh: 把雞蛋和麵粉在大碗裡攪拌混合。

ex.en: She mixed up a quick salad for lunch.
ex.zh: 她很快拌了一份沙拉當午餐。

ex.en: Mix up the paint until the color looks even.
ex.zh: 把顏料調勻，直到顏色看起來均勻。
